DD2MODCONFIG-SHOULD_PLAY_DEATH_DOOR_VFX_: Should Play Death Door Vfx If Poisoned
Should Play Death Door Vfx If Poisoned
Whenever your Hp or Poison changes, if your current Hp is equal to Poison or less, you will enter Death Door.
Should Play Death Door Vfx If Doomed
Should Play Death Door Vfx If Doomed
Same as Poisoned, but Vfx will only trigger during the creature's own turn.
Should Play Death Door Vfx If Low Health
Should Play Death Door Vfx If Low Health
Whenever your Hp decreases, if your current Hp is equal to Death Door Hp Percent or less, you will enter Death Door.

DD2MODCONFIG-SHOULD_MULTIPLAYER_USE_DEFA: If checked, default settings will be used in multiplayer mode. Be careful when unchecking! All online players must use the same config settings, otherwise there is a probability of data synchronization when encountering Death!
DD2MODCONFIG-SHOULD_DEATH_ONLY_HUNT_FLAG: Cancel toggle will allow all characters meet Death
If Checked, in multiplayer mode if has any DD2ModConfig in team, you may meet Death.
